name: The Country Round the Town
note: Hex codes from the export: T town, G pasture, R road, P path, W/F woodland and forest, H hills, S stream, C the compound clearing.

pins.dm: The sheep waits inside with the note.

pins.name: The Street
pins.blurb: The village square: temple, town hall, well and stables.

pins.blurb: The road east out of the village toward the hills.
pins.dm: Ambush point on the way to the tower.

pins.name: The Side Path

pins.name: Noke's Tower
